description: This source file defines application routes and navigation structure for a Flutter-based attendance tracker application. It includes route constants, route map configuration for MaterialApp, a placeholder for login UI, and some minimal scaffold UI components.

classes.name: AppRoutes
classes.description: A class encapsulating all route definitions, route map, and navigation logic for the Flutter app.

classes.name: _BaseScaffold
classes.description: A minimal scaffold widget with themed background, app bar, and content container.

classes.name: _LoginScreen
classes.description: A placeholder login screen widget with a button to navigate to the dashboard.

methods.name: routes
methods.description: Returns a map of route names to widget builders for the app's named routes.

methods.name: onGenerateRoute
methods.description: A method stub for handling dynamic route generation, currently returns null.

methods.description: Builds the scaffold UI with gradient background, app bar, and child widgets.
